verdicts.reason: A shrinks the square layout into a cluster in the middle of the canvas, leaving wide dead bands on both sides. Its attribution, logo and SOLSTICE label are tiny and hard to read, and the quote mark and the can float without a shared grid. B actually rearranges the design for the banner shape: the quote sits on the left, a large legible can sits on the right, and the brand colours hold up. Its flaws are a big empty gap between the quote mark and the quote text, the quote block sitting low against the bottom edge, and the logo moved to the top so it now competes with the quote mark.
